implementation: Python port of the Round 2 Receiving Manager rules (agents/receiving/engine.py) with Groq vision: one blind call per unit describes the photos, deterministic code compares with the PO (9 checks). No photos or a model failure gives UNCERTAIN / pending, never a guess. Needs GROQ_API_KEY; no Node required.
notes: In-process by default; also serves GET /health and POST /run: uvicorn agents.receiving.app:app --port 8101. Needs Node 20+, a one-time `npm ci` in agents/receiving/round2, and GEMINI_API_KEY in .env. Captures: data/input/<unit>/receiving/*.jpg (role from the file name: pallet, carton, unit, label).
